functions.name: artifact_deployment_records
functions.description: Artifact metadata deployment record occurrences for an organization and requested digest. Optional upstream IDs remain observations; ordinal identity exists only within this retrieval. All advertised Link pages are consumed. The optional total_count is not independently asserted; count measures returned occurrences. Raw timestamps remain strings because the pinned schema gives no date-time format. Attestation IDs are reported evidence, not joined to positional attestation envelope occurrences.

metrics.name: artifact_deployment_record_count
metrics.comment: Returned artifact_deployment_records rows at the declared retrieval-qualified occurrence grain.

arguments.name: organization
arguments.description: Explicit GitHub organization scope. Mutually exclusive with owner and repository.

arguments.name: artifact_subject_digest
arguments.description: SHA256 artifact metadata subject digest in sha256: followed by64lowercase hexadecimal digits.

routes.population: Returned record occurrences in all advertised pages for the selected organization and digest; missing optional record IDs do not erase rows.

functions.name: artifact_storage_records
functions.description: Artifact metadata storage record occurrences for an organization and requested digest. Optional upstream IDs remain observations; ordinal identity exists only within this retrieval. All advertised Link pages are consumed. The optional total_count is not independently asserted; count measures returned occurrences. Raw timestamps remain strings because the pinned schema gives no date-time format. The repository field identifies a registry repository, not a GitHub repository relationship.

metrics.comment: Returned artifact_storage_records rows at the declared retrieval-qualified occurrence grain.

metrics.name: active_artifact_storage_record_count
metrics.comment: Returned storage record occurrences explicitly marked active.

functions.name: artifact_metadata_jobs
functions.description: Status observations of previously created artifact metadata cluster jobs, qualified by organization, cluster and job ID. Missing started_at and successful-mutation counts remain unknown. The pinned errors field is an array of arbitrary objects with no typed fields and is explicitly uncovered.

metrics.name: artifact_metadata_job_count
metrics.comment: Returned artifact_metadata_jobs rows at the declared retrieval-qualified occurrence grain.

metrics.name: pending_artifact_metadata_job_count
metrics.comment: Selected artifact metadata jobs whose observed lifecycle status is pending.

metrics.name: processing_artifact_metadata_job_count
metrics.comment: Selected artifact metadata jobs whose observed lifecycle status is processing.

metrics.name: completed_artifact_metadata_job_count
metrics.comment: Selected artifact metadata jobs whose observed lifecycle status is completed.

metrics.name: failed_artifact_metadata_job_count
metrics.comment: Selected artifact metadata jobs whose observed lifecycle status is failed.

artifact_metadata_mutated_record_count.comment: Records successfully mutated by selected jobs as reported in total_count; absent counts on pending/failed observations remain unknown. This read does not start a mutation.
